clo-author.role: Base pipeline (14 skills, 22 agents, hooks, rules) ported into this plugin's skills/agents/hooks/rules in Phase 2.

academic-research-skills.role: ARS integrity gate, anti-sycophancy guards, PRISMA, multi-style citations, AI-disclosure — merged into the ported agents/skills in Phase 2.

engram.role: Spaced-repetition learning engine. VENDORED (not a separate installed plugin) — scripts/engram.py, agents/engram-*.md, skills/_shared/{dialogue,problem}-grammar.md + explorable-contract.md, docs/, gold/ copied in directly; learn/recall/coach SKILL.md files adapted (simplified for Claude-Code-only, wiki/project linkage woven in). A diff here means: re-copy the changed upstream files, then re-apply the same adaptation by hand — not a plugin update.

obsidian-second-brain.role: Peer LLM-maintained vault system (OKM standard). NOT integrated — watched for adoptable ideas only. research-os is deliberately more rigorous for research (immutable sources, preserved contradictions, human-readable notes); a diff here means: scan new commits for patterns worth porting (freshness/confidence conventions, MOC/index ideas, capture->graduate flow, scheduled-agent designs), never a wholesale adoption.
